title.zh: Sanctioned A7 Announces USDT-to-SWIFT Payment Service

current_state.zh: Sanctioned payment provider A7 announced a new service that converts USDT stablecoin balances into SWIFT bank transfers, a crypto-to-traditional-banking bridge with potential sanctions-evasion implications.
